title: klin harness protocol event, version 1
description: One lifecycle event a harness klin does not maintain sends klin on stdin. A harness sends only the evidence it can prove; a field it cannot prove is left out.

klin_protocol.description: The version of the harness protocol. klin speaks version 1 and refuses every other version.

event.description: Which lifecycle event this is. It selects the klin command the integration runs.

root.description: The absolute path of the repository the agent is working in. Left out when the integration runs klin inside that repository.

session.description: The harness's own id for the conversation. klin records it and judges nothing by it.

prompt.description: The text a person submitted. The prompt event alone carries it.

tool.description: The harness's name for the tool about to run. It is diagnostic: klin never reads a file write out of it.

file_paths.description: The paths the harness can prove this tool call will touch. Left out or empty when the harness cannot prove any.

command.description: The shell command the agent is about to run, when the harness knows it. Left out for a tool that runs no command.

blocked_before.description: Whether this integration already blocked a stop in this turn. A harness that cannot tell sends false or leaves it out.
